```{r load}
library(tidyverse)
library(e1071)
library(caret)
df <- read_csv("../data/bc_full_factorial_dataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
factors <- c("pH", "Temp_C", "RPM", "Inoculum_pct", "Sugar_gL")
cond_means <- df %>% group_by(across(all_of(factors))) %>%
  summarise(mean_yield = mean(BC_yield_gL), .groups = "drop")
preproc <- preProcess(cond_means[, factors], method = c("center", "scale"))
cond_scaled <- predict(preproc, cond_means[, factors])
cond_scaled$yield <- cond_means$mean_yield
set.seed(42)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(cond_scaled$yield, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train <- cond_scaled[train_idx, ]; test <- cond_scaled[-train_idx, ]
```

## Exercise 1 — Compare kernels
```{r ex1}
results <- data.frame()
for (k in c("linear", "polynomial", "radial")) {
  if (k == "polynomial") {
    m <- svm(yield ~ ., data = train, kernel = k, degree = 2, cost = 1)
  } else {
    m <- svm(yield ~ ., data = train, kernel = k, cost = 1)
  }
  p <- predict(m, newdata = test)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((test$yield - p)^2))
  r2 <- cor(test$yield, p)^2
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(kernel = k, RMSE = rmse, R2 = r2))
}
print(results)
```

## Exercise 2 — Feature importance
```{r ex2}
base_rmse <- sqrt(mean((test$yield - predict(best_svr, newdata = test))^2))
importance <- data.frame()
for (f in factors) {
  test_shuff <- test
  test_shuff[[f]] <- sample(test_shuff[[f]])
  p <- predict(best_svr, newdata = test_shuff)
  importance <- rbind(importance, data.frame(feature = f, rmse_increase = sqrt(mean((test$yield - p)^2)) - base_rmse))
}
print(importance %>% arrange(desc(rmse_increase)))
```
